messages:
deploy-bot: Canary starting in ~2m for service=llm-routing image=redwood/llm-route:v2.4.0. Planned flag change: llm_geo_split -> 10% (US) / 10% (EU) -> target 50% split over 60m. Change window 00:00-04:00 UTC. @julia @mike

julia: holding the EU portion. staging replay shows EU p99 jump +22% vs baseline. not comfortable with region split until investigated.

mike: can we limit to US only for now and keep EU at 0%? prefer to avoid cross-region noise.

ops-ash: set llm_geo_split EU=0% for canaries and paused automation for EU. Logged: "geo-split hold - regional p99 variance" :pause_button:

qa-lee: kicking focused EU cold-start and warmup tests against v2.4.0. capturing traces and pod-level metrics. ETA ~12m.

julia: thanks. if traces show slower KV warmup in EU, we'll add regional warmup hook to rollout config (prefetch + kv-seed) and re-run. if not, fallback = pin EU traffic to v2.3.9 and abort EU rollout.

mike: rollback/pin snippet for quick action:
```
redwoodctl route pin --service llm-routing --region eu --version v2.3.9 --reason "regional p99 regression"
redwoodctl deploy abort --id 1777654321 --region eu
```

ops-ash: draft release-note saved: "Canary partially paused: EU ramp deferred due to p99 variance; US canary continues. Investigating." Pinging PM @pm-ana and support. :white_check_mark:

qa-lee: test results: EU cold-start traces show higher CPU steal and delayed KV population on new image (consistent across 5 traces). Attaching trace ids. Recommendation: add warmup hook + small EU ramp (1% -> 5%) after fix.

julia: agree. plan: keep EU flag at 0%, push warmup tweak to rollout config, re-run EU staging, then conservative regional ramp with safety gate (abort if p99 > baseline +8% for 10m).

mike: US ramp continues at planned increments but ops-ash please keep safety gate on globally.

ops-ash: safety gate updated and EU remain paused. PM notified, ticket annotated. deploy-bot: hold EU rollout until manual resume by @julia or @mike. Logs: https://artifacts.redwood.internal/deploys/1777654321

deploy-bot: Hold acknowledged. Canary state: US progressing, EU queued on manual resume.
